settings.purpose: the model that drafts the plan. The package names no model of its own: absent, the model the host runs agents on (AGENT_MODEL) is used, and with neither the job is refused in words. A name starting google-vertex-anthropic/ is Claude on Google Vertex AI, paid for with a token from the machine it runs on, and the credential is then where to call, <project>/<location>. A bare name is a Gemini model at Google and the credential is its key. Any other name with a provider in front is refused in words.
the estimated cost to build one new agent, written into the plan as new_agent_usd for the platform to count after Source. Default 1.50.

directories.name: records
directories.purpose: one folder per job, holding the model calls, what the checks changed, and what the job went without
